d: Nabeh, a subsidiary of Master Works, delivers AI-powered solutions that help organizations automate operations, boost efficiency, and drive innovation. Its expertise spans computer vision, LLM applications, speech-to-text, data intelligence, and low-code AI solutions.

Nabeh is looking for an AI Product Engineer (Computer Vision & VLM) to develop, integrate, optimize, and deploy Vision Language Models (VLMs), computer vision solutions, and real-time video analytics capabilities across its Baseer product portfolio. The role focuses on transforming live camera feeds, recorded videos, and images into actionable insights, structured events, and AI-driven workflows for enterprise applications.
q: Hands-on experience with OpenCV, PyTorch, and computer vision models.
Practical experience with object detection and tracking models, including YOLO.
Experience processing images and video from cameras or recorded sources.
Strong understanding of image preprocessing, inference pipelines, and model performance metrics.
Familiarity with VLMs such as Qwen-VL, LLaVA, or equivalent.
Experience developing backend APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Familiarity with Linux, Docker, Git, and AI deployment workflows.
Ability to troubleshoot model accuracy, performance, and video pipeline issues.
Fluency in both Arabic and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
Experience with real-time multi-camera video analytics platforms.
Knowledge of RTSP, GStreamer, FFmpeg, and video codecs such as H.264/H.265.
Experience with tracking frameworks such as ByteTrack or DeepSORT.
Experience with segmentation, pose estimation, OCR, and action recognition.
Familiarity with video-language models and temporal video understanding.
Experience with ONNX, TensorRT, model quantization, and inference acceleration.
Experience deploying AI workloads on NVIDIA Jetson, NVIDIA GPUs, or Qualcomm AI platforms.
Knowledge of video management systems, camera integration, and edge computing.
Experience with Kubernetes and distributed inference architectures.
Experience developing AI solutions for transportation, aviation, surveillance, industrial inspection, or smart cities.
r: Develop and integrate computer vision models for object detection, tracking, classification, segmentation, and visual event recognition.
Implement solutions using YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, and other modern computer vision frameworks.
Design video analytics pipelines for multi-camera environments.
Build use cases involving people counting, occupancy, object tracking, activity recognition, safety compliance, and operational monitoring.
Implement video analytics workflows involving regions of interest, event triggers, and configurable business rules.
Evaluate accuracy under real-world conditions, including variable lighting, occlusions, camera angles, and environmental changes.
Integrate VLMs to analyze images, video frames, and visual events using natural-language instructions.
Develop visual question answering, image understanding, scene description, and visual reasoning capabilities.
Combine traditional computer vision models with VLMs to improve contextual understanding and event interpretation.
Build video summarization, semantic video search, and natural-language querying capabilities.
Develop multimodal workflows combining visual intelligence with LLMs, RAG, and AI agents.
Evaluate VLM performance, accuracy, hallucinations, latency, and inference cost.
Design and implement video ingestion and processing pipelines using RTSP, GStreamer, FFmpeg, or equivalent technologies.
Build scalable architectures for processing multiple concurrent video streams.
Implement frame sampling, batching, inference scheduling, stream recovery, and efficient resource utilization.
Optimize video processing performance to meet target FPS, latency, and infrastructure requirements.
Transform video events into structured metadata, alerts, searchable information, and business insights.
Work with both live camera feeds and recorded video sources.
Deploy and optimize computer vision and VLM models on cloud, on-premises, and edge infrastructure.
Work with NVIDIA GPUs and edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson.
Support inference optimization using TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, or equivalent frameworks.
Explore deployment and optimization on Qualcomm Cloud AI accelerators where supported.
Implement model benchmarking, performance monitoring, and resource utilization tracking.
Integrate models with video management systems and enterprise applications.
Develop backend APIs and services to integrate AI models into web-based products and dashboards.
Build reusable computer vision pipelines and configurable analytics components.
Collaborate with product managers and UI/UX engineers to deliver complete product features.
Create configurable use cases rather than hardcoded customer-specific implementations.
Contribute to product architecture, technical documentation, automated testing, and release processes.
Own assigned features from development through deployment and ongoing optimization.

d: Unternehmensbeschreibung Cherry Ventures ist ein wachstumsorientiertes Unternehmen, das innovative Dienstleistungen und Projekte im Gesundheits- und Sozialbereich unterstützt. Im Fokus stehen nachhaltige Lösungen, die die Lebensqualität von Patient:innen und Klient:innen verbessern. Das Umfeld ist dynamisch, international geprägt und bietet Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und eigene Ideen einzubringen. Teamarbeit, respektvoller Umgang und die Förderung individueller Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sind zentrale Bestandteile der Unternehmenskultur.

Rollenbeschreibung Als Assistent:in in der Ergotherapie unterstützen Sie Ergotherapeut:innen bei der Planung und Durchführung von therapeutischen Maßnahmen für Patient:innen in verschiedenen Altersgruppen. Zu Ihren täglichen Aufgaben gehören die Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Therapieeinheiten, die Unterstützung bei Übungen zur Förderung von Motorik, Alltagskompetenzen und Selbstständigkeit sowie die Dokumentation von Behandlungsverläufen. Sie begleiten Patient:innen im Alltagstraining, helfen bei der Organisation von Terminen und wirken an der Abstimmung mit Angehörigen sowie anderen Fachkräften mit. Die Stelle ist in Vollzeit, findet ausschließlich vor Ort statt und ist in Manama angesiedelt.
Ergotherapie & Rehabilitation: Sie sollten Kenntnisse in der Ergotherapie und Rehabilitationsprozessen besitzen, um therapeutische Maßnahmen fachgerecht zu unterstützen.
Patientenbetreuung & Hausbesuche: Erfahrung in der Patient:innenversorgung sowie in der Durchführung oder Begleitung von Home-Care-Einsätzen ist wünschenswert.
Programm- und Angebotsentwicklung: Fähigkeit zur Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung von Therapieprogrammen und individuellen Förderplänen wird erwartet.
Fachliche Voraussetzungen: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Qualifikation im ergotherapeutischen oder therapeutischen Assistenzbereich; Grundkenntnisse in medizinischer Dokumentation und Hygiene.
Persönliche Kompetenzen: Ausgeprägte Empathie, Geduld, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise.
Zusätzliche Vorteile: Kenntnisse in Englisch, interkulturelle Sensibilität, Erfahrung im Umgang mit digitalen Dokumentationssystemen und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen fachlichen Weiterbildung.

Sofitel Riyadh Hotel & Convention Center: A Symphony of French Elegance and Saudi Arabian Warmth

The Sofitel Riyadh is dedicated to providing a five-star experience characterized by luxury, elegance, and impeccable service. The hotel's commitment to personalized attention ensures that each guest's stay is not just comfortable but memorable. Blending urban sophistication with refined opulence, the Sofitel Riyadh creates an atmosphere where every detail is thoughtfully curated to offer a unique and unforgettable experience.

As Director of Engineering at Sofitel Riyadh, you will lead and oversee all engineering and maintenance operations, ensuring the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and operational excellence throughout the hotel. You will be responsible for implementing effective preventive maintenance programs, maintaining the reliability of hotel facilities and equipment, and ensuring a safe, comfortable, and exceptional environment for our guests and Heartists.

With strong leadership, technical expertise, and a hands-on approach, you will guide the Engineering team, collaborate with other departments, and ensure the smooth operation of our luxury hotel and convention facilities.
Lead and manage the Engineering Department, ensuring efficient daily operations and compliance with hotel standards and operational objectives.
Develop, implement, and monitor comprehensive preventive maintenance programs covering guest rooms, public areas, meeting and convention facilities, and all technical systems.
Oversee the operation, maintenance, and reliability of all mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other critical hotel systems.
Ensure prompt and effective responses to maintenance requests from guests, Heartists, and hotel management, minimizing disruption to hotel operations.
Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental operating budget, ensuring effective cost control and optimal resource utilization.
Monitor energy and water consumption, implementing initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and support sustainability objectives.
Ensure full compliance with applicable building codes, fire and life safety regulations, occupational health and safety standards, and local regulatory requirements.
Lead emergency preparedness and response activities, ensuring the readiness and reliability of all critical systems and safety equipment.
Manage engineering service contracts, external contractors, and suppliers to ensure quality, compliance, and cost-effective service delivery.
Oversee the recruitment, scheduling, performance management, training, and development of Engineering Heartists.
Conduct regular inspections of hotel facilities and equipment to identify maintenance needs, operational risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Coordinate and ensure the successful completion of all engineering-related inspections, audits, and risk management requirements.
Work closely with Rooms Division, Food & Beverage, Culinary, Events, and other departments to support seamless hotel operations and exceptional guest experiences.
Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement within the Engineering Department.
Ensure the Engineering Department maintains accurate maintenance records, equipment documentation, and compliance reports.
Participate actively in hotel management meetings and operational committees, contributing to overall hotel performance and strategic objectives.
Remain available to respond to operational emergencies and critical maintenance situations when required.
q: Proven leadership experience in engineering or facilities management within luxury hotels, resorts, or large-scale hospitality environments.
Strong technical expertise in engineering operations, facilities management, preventive maintenance, and asset lifecycle planning.
Relevant qualifications in Engineering, Building Services, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Demonstrated experience managing engineering operations within an established luxury hotel, ensuring business continuity, asset reliability, and minimal disruption to guest services.
Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management, CAPEX planning, project execution, contract management, and cost optimization.
Comprehensive knowledge of building codes, fire and life safety regulations, and local regulatory requirements, including the Saudi Building Code and Civil Defense standards.
Proven experience in emergency preparedness, risk management, and maintaining fire and life safety systems within large-scale facilities.
Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop, motivate, and inspire high-performing teams.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
Highly organized, results-driven, and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively under pressure.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
Strong commitment to sustainability, energy efficiency, operational excellence, and maintaining exceptional guest and Heartist experiences.
Hands-on leadership approach, leading by example and fostering a culture of accountability, safety, continuous improvement, and high performance.
Experience overseeing engineering operations in large-scale hotels with extensive meeting, conference, and convention facilities is highly desirable.

d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Financial Planning Analyst / Senior Financial Advisor / Cost Control Specialist

We are a business-focused organization committed to strengthening financial performance, improving resource allocation, and supporting sustainable growth. Through financial analysis, strategic planning, and effective cost management, we aim to help organizations make informed decisions and maintain strong financial discipline.

We are seeking an experienced finance professional to support financial planning, performance analysis, and cost management initiatives. This role combines analytical expertise with practical financial insight to help evaluate business performance, identify financial risks, and improve operational efficiency.

Working remotely with flexible part-time hours, you will collaborate with management and relevant departments to prepare financial forecasts, assess expenditure, review financial results, and provide recommendations that support business objectives.
Prepare and review financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and performance reports.
Analyze financial results to identify trends, variances, and improvement opportunities.
Monitor operating costs, expenditure patterns, and budget utilization.
Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business planning.
Evaluate cost structures and recommend practical cost optimization strategies.
Provide financial insights and recommendations to support management decisions.
Review departmental budgets and assess performance against financial targets.
Support cash flow planning, resource allocation, and financial risk assessments.
Collaborate with finance, operations, and business teams on financial initiatives.
Monitor key financial indicators and contribute to continuous improvement in financial controls.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in financial planning, financial analysis, or cost management preferred.
Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and cost analysis.
Knowledge of financial modelling, variance analysis, and performance measurement.
Familiarity with cost control methods and financial planning processes.
Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial reporting tools, and data analysis.
Ability to interpret financial information and communicate practical recommendations.
Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to manage priorities independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
Opportunities to contribute to financial planning and business performance initiatives.
Exposure to strategic financial analysis and cost optimization projects.
Professional development in financial management, forecasting, and business advisory.
A collaborative environment that values analytical thinking, accountability, and continuous improvement.
